data.title: 白面鸮 · 面包店采购
data.description: 她对照清单确认了面包数量，提起纸袋离开柜台，还记得多带一份给同事。
data.promptProse: Standing beside a sunlit glass bakery counter, Ptilopsis holds a brown paper bag filled with fresh artisan baguettes while verifying an itemized receipt. Golden morning light floods through plate-glass windows across pristine pastry displays and polished tile flooring.
data.animaCaption: Holding the warm bag of bread securely in one arm, she reviews the receipt with disciplined precision before stepping into the street.
